correctness.rationale: PASS: For the arbitrary-complex four-term polynomial, centering and the t versus t+pi parallelogram identity give M² at least the squared even/odd parts. A sharp Fejér–Riesz degree-two nonnegative polynomial factorization gives the harmonic envelope with p=|ad|, q=|bc|: m(q,p)=2p+q²/(4p) for q<=4p and 2q-2p otherwise. AM–GM and two explicitly bounded one-variable rational profiles imply upper ratio squared <=(3+sqrt(5))/2; the opposite branch <=7/3. Substituting rho=sqrt(5)-1 into 1+rho z+rho z³-z⁴ gives sup norm 5-sqrt(5) and coefficient l1 2sqrt(5), attaining phi. Boundaries p=0, q=0, x=0 are covered by the envelope branch/continuity and elementary degenerate polynomial cases. Examined actual verify.py exact Q(sqrt5) rational identities; finite random test is only corroborative.

Neuwirth 2026 arXiv:2603.28229 treats {0,1,2,3}, not affinely equivalent to {0,1,3,4} (gap patterns 1,1,1 versus 1,2,1). Published finite cyclic characters and 2x2 frequency rectangles live on different groups/parameter metrics and do not imply this circle Sidon constant. Actual Resultary and literature searches did not locate exact number with same frequency support; older unindexed unconditional-basis results remain risk.
